source.name: FIRST Tech Challenge Perimeter Kit, Rev B

coordinateSystem.axes: +X and +Z lie on the field floor; +Y is vertical.
coordinateSystem.sourceOrigin: The field is horizontally centred at the local origin; the lowest perimeter point is 0.005969 m below local Y=0.

sceneFilter.reason: The optional mid-field retention straps and clips are not field markings and are omitted from the simulator scene.

materialProfile.name: ftc-perimeter
materialProfile.reason: The source STEP has no colors; named parts are rendered as aluminum rails, clear polycarbonate panels, and steel fasteners.

worldPlacement.effect: Places the lowest perimeter point on world Y=0 while retaining a field-centred X/Z origin.

cornerAtWorldOriginPlacement.effect: Optional placement for a coordinate system whose southwest field corner is world X=0, Z=0.
